observations: apple_wdt_probe detects WD1 running, initializes timeout from firmware/DT, then calls apple_wdt_set_timeout before registration. set_timeout resets current-time and replaces bite-time; an earlier loader deadline cannot be assumed to survive probe unchanged.

watchdog registration starts its pre-userspace ping timer only when handle_boot_enabled is true. The exact candidate configuration defaults it false; an explicit boot parameter can override that default.
The open_timeout default is15 seconds, not zero. It is not independent remote recovery proof; no new DT/boot command line has been qualified.

A kernel watchdog worker, userspace process or firmware can change effective behavior. These source observations do not establish the cause of any previous failed recovery or demonstrate any hardware deadline.
decision: Keep unattended boot blocked. A supervised test still needs independently reviewed concrete loader/DT/kernel/initrd inputs and a physically available recovery operator.
